title: Skyline Rush — Purchase Funnel
description: Shop view -> initiate -> complete, by SKU and age bucket. Implements 12_ANALYTICS_AND_OBSERVABILITY.md §Dashboards bullet 2. Per that doc the age-bucket split is a fairness/compliance signal — confirming no purchase pressure disproportionately converts younger cohorts — and is explicitly NOT a growth-optimization target for minors. Panels marked "skylineMetricStatus": "placeholder" reference metrics this prototype does not emit yet.

panels.title: Receipt-validation failure rate (15m)
panels.description: Numerator/denominator both from libs/metrics. Pages above 2% via SkylineReceiptValidationFailureRate, which additionally requires >= 10 absolute failures in the window. RF-06: the numerator counts only failures a caller cannot manufacture (entitlement-grant failures, vanished player rows). Unknown SKUs, malformed bodies and missing parental gates are counted separately in skyline_receipt_client_rejections_total and are deliberately excluded, because guest tokens are issued to anyone and would otherwise let a stranger drive this stat to 100%.

panels.title: Receipt validations — attempted vs. failed
panels.description: Absolute volumes behind the failure-rate stat, so a low-traffic ratio spike is distinguishable from a real incident.

panels.title: Purchase endpoint traffic by status
panels.description: POST /v1/purchases/receipt broken out by HTTP status from http_requests_total. 402 indicates insufficient balance, 403 a failed parental gate on a minor purchase.

panels.title: Duplicate receipt submissions
panels.description: Idempotent replays. Duplicate submissions must never double-grant (CLAUDE.md §3); this panel is the visible proof the guard is firing rather than silently double-granting. RF-07 scope caveat: skyline_idempotent_replay_total is app-wide, not purchase-only — it also counts replayed supply-drop opens and contract claims from EconomyService, so this series is an upper bound on duplicate receipt submissions rather than an exact count.

panels.title: Conversion by SKU and age bucket (compliance view)
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER: skyline_purchase_funnel_total{stage,sku,age_bucket} is not emitted by this prototype. The gateway metrics middleware labels only method/path/status and deliberately does not attach age_bucket, so funnel stages cannot be reconstructed from http_requests_total. Emitting this requires an aggregate-only exporter that never joins age_bucket to a player_id, per 08_SAFETY_PRIVACY_COMPLIANCE.md. Renders No Data until then.
